MOLDESIGN / UPDATES

From the lab.

MolDesign is a desktop application to produce, organize and communicate structural computational evidence in early-stage drug research. Every result keeps the structure, configuration and conditions that produced it, and the app works offline.

DESKTOP EDITION · V1.0.1
RELEASE NOTES
In progress · not released
Coming in version 1.0.2

The next release focuses on evidence and provenance corrections. These changes are documented in development and are not part of the installed version yet.

01
The primary ranking returns to Vina's observed affinity.
02
Evaluations declare when ligand tautomerism remains unresolved.
03
Targets whose binding site cannot be prepared are marked unavailable, with the reason.
04
The result and the dossier declare which reference residues each run used.
05
History keeps every run with its provenance and drops the aggregate scores.
06
Structural preparation audits whether a system can be handed to a later calculation (in development).
07
The peptide route (ESMFold) is marked experimental.
08
Molcy joins as Beta: videos of your runs made with Blender.
Visit the MolDesign website

WHAT IT IS

A way to record what evidence each run produced: structure, configuration, controls passed and the uncertainty that remains.
An auditor, in development, of whether a structural system can be handed to a later calculation; it does not certify compatibility with any provider.
A tool that abstains: it tells you when not to trust a number.

WHAT IT IS NOT

It does not predict biological activity or replace experimental validation.
It does not run molecular dynamics or free-energy (FEP) calculations.
It is not a cloud service: all computation is local.

OPEN SCIENCE

The record of what held up and what changed.

Experiments, measurements, refutations and corrections with their conditions in view.

COMING SOON

WHAT'S INSIDE
Six tools, one way of keeping the evidence.

EVALUATION

Docks a molecule with AutoDock Vina and gathers the evidence of the run.

BATCH

Evaluates a series of molecules under one configuration and declares its coverage.

PREPARATION

Audits the structural system before a later calculation. It does not run FEP.

MOLDEX

A library of what you evaluated, with a 3D viewer and a PDF report.

HISTORY

All your runs, each with its provenance.

MOLCY (BETA)

Videos of a run made with Blender, which the app can install for you.
